title: Pulse-Amplitude-Modulation (PAM) Fluorometry and Fv/Fm Quantum Yield Kinetics under Rapid Spectrum Transitions
author: Dr. vmffkxhs2362
abstract: Photosystem II (PSII) maximum quantum efficiency (Fv/Fm) reflects non-photochemical quenching (NPQ) and photoinhibition. We measured real-time PAM fluorescence kinetics in spinach leaves subjected to step-change transitions between broad-spectrum white and dynamic blue/red LED ratios. Transient NPQ relaxation kinetics indicated that a 15-minute gradual spectral ramp prevents PSII acceptor side photoinhibition.
key_findings: Step transitions from 100 to 500 μmol/m²/s induced transient Fv/Fm decline from 0.83 to 0.69.
Gradual 15-minute spectral ramping maintained Fv/Fm above 0.80 throughout the photoperiod transition.
NPQ kinetics revealed qE relaxation half-time of 2.4 minutes under blue spectrum enrichment.
